llms.name: Leap International Corporate Service Limited
llms.summary: Leap International is a Hong Kong corporate services firm that helps foreigners and local founders incorporate, operate and stay compliant in Hong Kong. Services cover company incorporation, corporate secretary, accounting, bookkeeping, audit and profits tax filing, annual return filing, and registered office address. The firm is based in Tsim Sha Tsui East, Kowloon, Hong Kong and provides bilingual (English / Traditional Chinese) support with transparent, published pricing.
